definitions.short: Betsalel , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H1212. Betsalel בְּצַלְאֵל proper name, masculine ( in the shadow (protection) of El ; compare cuneiform ‚il-Bêl , a king of Gaza, COT Josh 11:22 ) — 1 a skilled artisan of tribe of Judah Exod 31:2 ; 35:30 ; 36:1-2 , 37:1 ; 38:22 (all P) 1Chr 2:20 ; 2Chr 1:5 . 2 an Israelite Ezra 10:30 .
definitions.rootNote: probably from 6738 and 410 with a prepositional prefix; in (the) shadow (i.e. protection) of God ;
